summary: The statement follows from the supplied accepted predecessor estimates with no mathematical errors or gaps. Maximizing the one-coordinate capacity simultaneously attains the endpoint lower bound and the uniform average lower bound, so the modified raw capacities give the asserted depth at an original point in each row. The continuous geometric-sum profile is increasing and concave for every permitted ratio, and the floor comparison, narrow-coordinate inequality, and wide-coordinate interpolation all have the stated directions and constants. The common-midpoint construction gives at most two blocks of each active cardinality; each block profile satisfies the exact hypotheses of the cited scalar Gaussian estimate without using the predecessor's tilt restriction. The product exponents yield the stated ratio rho below one, and summing the blocks gives the claimed absolute constant with the correct conversion from 2^n to 2^N. Singleton coordinates and blocks, N=1, zero and noninteger endpoint widths, arbitrarily large finite tilts, and all containing closed halfspaces are covered while preserving the original support and weights.
